fixtureManifest.scope: Build/compile only. Full actual ShopUI modules differ only by forbidden-request Marketplace provider substitution. Original product/pass IDs remain zero and price provider must receive zero calls; action logger has no network/prompt method. Actual Client helpers/card widths; non-boost cards hidden after full Render; ColorMixer never called. No normal Client, server Bootstrap, profiles or purchase/receipt execution.
limits: Logical sizes are not physical-device evidence.
Original zero IDs produce COMING SOON; no price service request is allowed.
Actual purchase/saved buttons send only to the fixture action logger; no real purchase/receipt or persistence claim.
Expires case uses actual2.1second wait and Tick with no clock substitution; no long-running countdown/performance claim.

native.runtimeMethod: Existing disposable local place supplied unchanged Config/Catalog.
